description: Canonical editorial stance enum for Source nodes. POV is a property of the Source, not of individual Documents. Documents inherit the stance from their producing Source.

independent.label: Independent
independent.description: Privately owned outlet with no declared state or party affiliation, typically professional journalism with editorial independence

state_media.label: State Media
state_media.description: Owned, operated, or directly funded by a national government; editorial line tracks the funding state's foreign and domestic policy

partisan.label: Partisan
partisan.description: Privately owned but with explicit political alignment to a party or movement

advocacy.label: Advocacy
advocacy.description: Issue-driven outlet whose mission is advancing a specific cause

opinion.label: Opinion / Commentary
opinion.description: Source dominated by op-eds, columns, and commentary rather than reporting

satire.label: Satire
satire.description: Source explicitly labeled as satirical; not factual

official_government.label: Official Government
official_government.description: Government agency publishing in its official capacity (alerts, datasets, statistics, press releases)

user_generated.label: User-Generated
user_generated.description: Platform where individual users post content; the platform is the source but content varies by author

aggregator.label: Aggregator
aggregator.description: Platform that collects and ranks user-submitted links to other sources; not original reporting

content._doc: When stance is unknown, default to 'independent' rather than null. The classifier should be deliberate about non-default classifications.
